snippet.title: Saturn Longplay [203] Ninku: Tsuyokina Yatsura no Daigekitotsu! (JP)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: SCHLAUCHI

Ninku: Tsuyokina Yatsura no Daigekitotsu is a fighting game for the Sega Saturn that is based on the popular Japanese anime and manga series of the same name. The game features a wide variety of characters from the series, each with their unique martial arts skills and special moves.

Players can choose to take on the single-player story mode or go head-to-head against a friend in the player versus player mode. The game features fast-paced, action-packed gameplay that is easy to pick up but challenging to master.
